fertiliser.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: NPK 15:15:15; sealed 50 kg bag; state brand, batch and manufacture date. Urea requires a separate quote.

seeds.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Certified improved maize seed, 2 kg sealed pack, named variety and germination rate. Tree seedlings must be priced individually by species and age.

agrochemicals.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One sealed 1 L herbicide bottle; specify active ingredient, concentration, registration and expiry; no interchangeable product assumption.

sprayer.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Manual 16 L backpack sprayer, adjustable nozzle, lance, straps and repair seals; exclude motorised/premium models.

farm_tools.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One cutlass and one hoe with fitted handles; state steel quality and dimensions.

livestock.specification: Assumed scope: One healthy medium-sized adult goat or sheep/ram, approximately 20–40 kg live weight; actual breed, sex and weight determine quote. Transport and veterinary checks extra.

poultry.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One vaccinated day-old broiler chick, named hatchery and strain. Define full starter pack separately: number of chicks, feed, drinkers, feeders and veterinary support.

fishery.specification: Assumed scope: Catfish fingerlings approximately 5–8 cm; pond allowance for one 3 m × 2 m × 1 m tarpaulin tank with frame and outlet. Fish, feed, site slab and water supply separate.

tractor_support.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One hectare, one ploughing pass; state soil condition, site access, mobilisation and fuel; harrowing/ridging quoted separately.

processing_machine.specification: Assumed scope: One locally fabricated small cassava grater OR maize sheller, approximately 200–500 kg/hour, with small engine/motor; not a complete processing line. Confirm actual throughput.

cash_grant.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One-off microbusiness grant; define eligibility, approved amount, disbursement method and any separate training package.

cash_palliative.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One cash transfer for the specified support cycle; define frequency and number of recipients.

widow_support.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One-off cash support; separate food, equipment or livelihood packages if provided.

scholarship.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Partial annual bursary. Full scholarship must specify tuition, accommodation, books, course and institution.

disability_support.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One-off cash or livelihood support; define purpose and eligibility. Personalised assistive devices budgeted separately.

elderly_support.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Cash or food support for one stated monthly/quarterly/one-off cycle; medical care and home support separately scoped.

town_hall.specification: Assumed scope: 150 m² single-storey basic hall at assumed ₦200,000–400,000/m². Basic finishes and electrical work; land, furniture, external works and standalone toilet block extra.

worship_support.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Define cash contribution or named renovation/material package; record beneficiary institution and scope.

cemetery.specification: Assumed scope: Existing approximately 1,000 m² site; basic clearance, approximately 130 m perimeter fence, one gate and simple paths. No land purchase, major drainage or buildings.

ict_equipment.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: New laptop, Core i5/Ryzen 5 equivalent, 8 GB RAM minimum, 256 GB SSD minimum, licensed OS, charger and warranty; state processor generation.

classroom_block.specification: Assumed scope: One 8 m × 7 m classroom plus proportionate veranda/shared structure, approximately 70 m² gross allocation; basic finishes. A three-room block is approximately ₦45m–75m. Furniture/toilets extra.

school_renovation.specification: Assumed scope: One 8 m × 7 m classroom: moderate roof, floor, plaster/paint, doors/windows and electrical repairs; excludes major structural reconstruction.

school_furniture.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One desk plus seating for two pupils; specify timber/steel or moulded design, age group, dimensions and finish.

exam_fees.specification: Assumed scope: One student sitting one examination; JAMB 2026 fee package with/without mock. WAEC/NECO numbers are provisional support allowances, not verified official fees; exclude tuition/transport.

school_books.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Ten 40–60-leaf exercise books, two pens, two pencils, ruler, eraser and sharpener; textbooks and school bag excluded.

school_fence.specification: Assumed scope: 2.1 m high block fence, standard foundations and columns on ordinary ground; basic finish. Gates and unusually deep foundations extra.

skills_training.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Example 4–8 week practical course; specify trade, contact hours, trainer, venue, consumables, assessment and certificate.

solar_street_light.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: LED luminaire with verified output, panel, battery and controller; 6–8 m pole, foundation and installation. Require documented nightly operating profile and warranty.

street_light_repair.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Fault diagnosis and replacement of specified lamp, battery, controller or wiring; existing pole assumed serviceable.

transformer.specification: Assumed scope: 300 kVA, 11 kV/415 V distribution transformer; installation allowance assumes local transport, plinth, standard protection, earthing and short cable runs. Major line extension extra; utility approval required.

transformer_repair.specification: Assumed scope: 300 kVA unit. Minor allowance: oil/service, bushings or connections; major allowance: substantial winding/components work. Diagnose and test before choosing allowance.

electric_pole.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Choose 8.54 m LT or 10.36 m HT reinforced concrete pole; approved loading class, traceable batch and certification; utility to confirm selection.

electric_cable.specification: Assumed scope: 100 m roll of 2.5 mm² single-core copper building wire, named manufacturer; not armoured cable or overhead power conductor. Installation extra.

power_extension.specification: Assumed scope: Short low-voltage overhead extension on accessible ground, approximately 40 m pole spacing, poles/conductors/fittings and installation. Excludes transformer, HT works and difficult crossings.

solar_home_system.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Lantern: rechargeable LED with panel. Home kit: panel, battery, controller, 3–4 LED lamps and phone charging; specify Wh capacity and runtime.

generator.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: New petrol generator around 2.5–3 kW continuous output; confirm continuous versus peak rating, warranty, noise and fuel consumption.

waste_bins.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Wheeled 240 L HDPE bin with lid; evacuation to specify truck volume, trips, collection frequency and disposal fees.

drainage.specification: Assumed scope: Open concrete drain, approximately 600 mm internal width × 600 mm depth on ordinary ground, assumed 150 mm base/walls subject to design; excavation and basic outfall connection. Covers/major outfall extra.

erosion_control.specification: Assumed scope: Small gabion retaining protection approximately 1 m high × 1 m wide, with prepared base/filter and minor drainage. Excludes deep gullies and major river training; engineered design required.

medical_outreach.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Basic consultation and screening package for a stated attendance; provider to itemise staffing, tests, consumables, venue and logistics.

free_drugs.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Provider-defined medicine package based on assessed needs; record generic names, strengths, quantities and expiry.

mosquito_nets.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Rectangular bed net, state exact dimensions and insecticidal-treatment status; for malaria programmes request approved long-lasting insecticidal nets.

phc_renovation.specification: Assumed scope: Existing approximately 150 m² primary healthcare building; moderate roof/finishes, electrical, plumbing and toilet repairs. No major structural rebuilding, equipment or extension.

medical_equipment.specification: Assumed scope: One examination couch, BP monitor, stethoscope, thermometer, weighing scale and instrument trolley; verify model, accessories and warranty. No laboratory/imaging or surgical equipment.

maternal_pack.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Facility-approved maternity consumables pack; specify gloves, underpads, maternity pads, cord clamps, baby wrap and exact quantities.

ambulance.specification: Assumed scope: Basic patient-transport tricycle OR inspected used van with stretcher and basic conversion. Not a new advanced-life-support ambulance; clinical equipment schedule and vehicle inspection required.

health_insurance.specification: Assumed scope: One basic individual health insurance policy for 12 months; actual OYSHIA eligibility, premium and benefits must be confirmed. This is a budgeting allowance, not an official tariff.

market_stall.specification: Assumed scope: One 3 m × 3 m lock-up shop; ordinary foundations, walls, roof, floor, steel door and basic wiring. Land and shared external services extra.

market_shed.specification: Assumed scope: One 3 m × 3 m open-sided steel-framed roofed bay on a concrete slab; basic foundation and installation. Land and extensive drainage extra.

palliative_food.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Example: rice 5 kg, beans 2 kg, garri 2 kg, vegetable oil 1 L and salt 500 g; sealed packaging and quantities documented.

rice.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Sealed 50 kg bag of parboiled rice; specify local/imported brand, grade, production date and net weight.

festive_relief.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Rice 5 kg, oil 1 L, pasta four 500 g packs, sugar 1 kg and other approved items; clearly list substitutions.

wheelchair.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Foldable self-propelled wheelchair, brakes, armrests and footrests; seat width and load capacity fitted to user.

mobility_aid.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Pair of height-adjustable adult crutches with rubber tips; state underarm or elbow type and size. Walking frames/sticks priced separately.

sensory_aid.specification: Assumed scope: Basic prescription single-vision spectacles with frame OR entry-level fitted hearing aid. Assessment, specialist lenses and advanced digital devices can cost more.

road_grading.specification: Assumed scope: Regrading an existing accessible 1 km × 6 m earth road, shaping/camber and limited compaction with shared mobilisation. No imported fill, major clearing or new drainage.

road_filling.specification: Assumed scope: 1 km × 6 m × 150 mm compacted laterite = 900 m³; approved material, moderate haul distance, spreading and compaction. No asphalt or major drainage.

road_asphalt.specification: Assumed scope: 1 km × 6 m = 6,000 m², 50 mm asphalt wearing course on an already sound prepared base. Full reconstruction, major base repair, drainage and land acquisition excluded.

pothole_repair.specification: Assumed scope: Cut/remove damaged material, minor base repair, tack coat and approximately 50 mm asphalt patch compacted. Original unit metres should be m²; deeper repairs cost more.

culvert.specification: Assumed scope: Single 900 mm diameter pipe crossing approximately 8 m long, ordinary excavation, bedding, headwalls and aprons; no major flow diversion or deep foundation. Design subject to hydraulic assessment.

bridge.specification: Assumed scope: Pedestrian steel bridge assumed 10 m span × 1.5 m width; vehicle bridge assumed 6 m span × 6 m width. Ordinary foundations; excludes deep piles and extensive approaches. Design mandatory.

security_post.specification: Assumed scope: One 3 m × 3 m guardhouse with roof, doors/windows, basic lighting and finish. Toilet, road barrier, solar system and site fencing extra.

vigilante_support.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Monthly support for one approved local security operative; define duty period, uniforms, torch, communications and supervision separately.

security_vehicle.specification: Assumed scope: New 125–150 cc motorcycle OR inspected used 2010–2015 class pickup in serviceable condition. Registration, insurance, radios, branding and operating expenses separate.

cctv.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Four HD/IP cameras as selected, recorder, 1 TB storage, power supply, cables and basic installation; specify camera resolution and coverage.

sewing_machine.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Butterfly JA2-1 or equivalent manual straight-stitch machine; confirm table, stand, pedal and accessories in quote.

grinding_machine.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Small beans grinding machine; supplier must confirm engine/motor, grinding head, throughput, stand and food-contact materials.

hairdressing_kit.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Barbing: two clippers, trimmer, disinfecting kit, combs/capes. Hairdressing: dryer, straightener, combs, rollers and accessories; state exact contents.

welding_machine.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Mains-powered MMA 250 A class machine; verify duty cycle, input power, leads and warranty; protective equipment separate.

block_machine.specification: Assumed scope: Small locally fabricated vibrating block machine, 6-inch/9-inch mould options and motor/engine; confirm mould count and output. Mixer, pallets, shed and working capital excluded.

deep_freezer.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: New approximately 200 L chest freezer, 230 V AC; named model, compressor warranty and energy rating.

trader_kit.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Define trade and itemised opening stock, display container and basic tools; quantity/brand for each component.

sports_kit.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One jersey, shorts and socks with basic printing; record size mix; boots, balls and team equipment excluded.

sports_competition.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Example: eight-team local tournament; itemise venue, officials, first aid, prizes, publicity and logistics.

playing_field.specification: Assumed scope: Approximately 60 m × 40 m existing earth/grass field; minor levelling, grass repairs, marking and two goalposts. No artificial turf, major drainage, stands or lighting.

motorcycle.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: New Bajaj Boxer/TVS class 125–150 cc motorcycle; specify model, warranty and included helmet/accessories.

tricycle.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: New Bajaj/TVS passenger tricycle; specify petrol or CNG, model and warranty. Cargo variants priced separately.

bus_shelter.specification: Assumed scope: 6 m × 2 m steel-framed shelter with roof, slab, simple seating and signage; ordinary foundations. Solar lighting and road reconstruction extra.

motor_park.specification: Assumed scope: Approximately 1,000 m² existing park; local surface repairs/compacted stone improvement, minor drains, markings and basic lighting. No full asphalt reconstruction or new buildings.

borehole.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Survey-led depth; drilling, casing, development, yield test, water-quality test and electric submersible pump. Tank/stand/network priced separately.

borehole_solar.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: New borehole plus correctly sized solar pump, PV array, controller, mounting and protection; define required head and daily yield; tank/stand separately.

borehole_repair.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: Diagnose pump, control panel, riser pipe and cable; distinguish electrical repair, pump replacement and redevelopment; replacement drilling excluded.

water_tank.specification: Suggested quoting baseline: One 2,000 L food-grade plastic water tank with lid; named brand and warranty; delivery, base/tower, valves and plumbing separate.

standpipe.specification: Assumed scope: Three taps on masonry/concrete stand, apron and soakaway, up to 20 m pipe connection to an existing supply. Borehole, storage and pumping excluded.

public_toilet.specification: Assumed scope: Approximately 30–40 m² basic four-cubicle block including accessible provision, handwashing and modest septic/soakaway on suitable ground. Borehole/long water connection extra.
